```plato

    // The tight bounds of the disk of `radius` centred at `center` with unit normal
    // `axis`.
    DiskBounds(center: Point3D, axis: Vector3D, radius: Number): Bounds3D
    {
        var e = DiskHalfExtents(axis, radius);
        return CenteredBounds(center, e.X, e.Y, e.Z);
    }
```
